behavior: axe-core 4.14 passes: every control's visible text is part of its accessible name (WCAG 2.5.3)
acceptance: Every control axe 4.14 flagged for label-content-name-mismatch has its visible text in its accessible name: the status menu, the profile switcher (sidebar and phone), the account menu, list row links and address tooltips
The e2e tests that find these controls by name use the new names
unit, lint, typecheck, build and e2e (with the privy specs) pass
notes: 2026-10-23 review pass by reviewer: The six controls now pass axe 4.14 label-in-name (WCAG 2.5.3): each name has the visible text in order. Layout is unchanged, the e2e checks are as strict as before, and lint, typecheck and unit tests pass. Follow-up: an email that starts with a digit still fails in the collapsed-sidebar and phone-header account IconButtons, because the visible initial is not a word in the aria-label.

proof.1: e2e: @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0 resolves axe-core 4.14.0; pnpm outdated -r lists nothing
proof.2: e2e: the a11y and privy e2e specs run blockingViolations under axe 4.14 with no label-content-name-mismatch: status menu, sidebar and phone profile switcher, account menu, counterparty link, truncated address
proof.3: e2e: the privy specs find the switcher as Switch profile: E2E shop Merchant, the phone button by Switch profile at the end, the account menu as Account: <email>, and the short address 0xcccc…cccc, whose tooltip shows the full address on focus
proof.4: e2e: unit, lint, typecheck, build and e2e (with the privy specs) pass
